subject: general
question:
The import and export of a country (in lakhs rupees) during a certain period of time is given in the following bar-graph. 

Read the bar - graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc56275a8bbe16f9a040be00c355c3364b5152ce3bc19d729852e5f7ad94129.png] 

What is the average of exports during the given period of time?
solution:
Calculation:

The average of exports during the given period of time = (825 + 1014 + 1240 + 1522 + 1650)/5 = Rs. 1,250.2 lakhs

**∴ The average of exports during the given period of time is Rs. 1,250.2 lakhs.**
